boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of Puget Sound traditions spanning Logger history, community observances, and annual campus gatherings.

cards.title: Find the Logger relic
cards.subtitle: University of Puget Sound school-pride tradition
cards.notes: See the replica in Wheelock Student Center, then read the campus account of the original hatchet’s 1908 discovery and legacy.
cards.short_summary: A historic hatchet became a lasting symbol of Logger pride.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says the hatchet was discovered in a campus barn in 1908 and became synonymous with school pride; a replica is displayed in Wheelock Student Center.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Replica display is in Wheelock Student Center; confirm building access before visiting.

cards.title: Line up at the Color Post
cards.subtitle: Karlen Quad commencement tradition
cards.notes: Spot the granite obelisk in Karlen Quad and look for the graduating-class record before Commencement season arrives.
cards.short_summary: Seniors gather at a class-marked obelisk before walking to Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says seniors line up at the Color Post every spring for Commencement before proceeding down Commencement Walk to Baker Stadium.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Observe the monument respectfully; the procession occurs during Commencement.

cards.title: Start fall at LogJam!
cards.subtitle: Annual fall-semester welcome festival
cards.notes: Check the university calendar near the start of fall term for the activities fair, food, performances, and fireworks.
cards.short_summary: An annual festival welcomes students back for the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound describes LogJam! as an annual fall-semester kickoff with a campus activities fair, food, musical performances, and fireworks.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult the university calendar for the current date and program.

cards.title: Wear maroon on Friday
cards.subtitle: Weekly Logger-spirit practice
cards.notes: Join the visible campus ritual by wearing maroon and white on a Friday; no special gear or purchase is necessary.
cards.short_summary: Friday is the campus’s regular show-your-Logger-colors day.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound identifies every Friday as Maroon Friday, when people on campus show Logger spirit by wearing maroon and white.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Occurs weekly during the academic year; participation is informal.

cards.title: Attend the Spring Lu'au
cards.subtitle: Ka Ohana me ke Aloha annual cultural celebration
cards.notes: Look for the April program during Spring Family Weekend and engage with the student performances and Pacific Islander cultural celebration.
cards.short_summary: A student-organized lu'au has marked spring at Puget Sound for decades.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says Ka Ohana me ke Aloha has organized an annual lu'au for more than 45 years, typically in April during Spring Family Weekend.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Typically held in April; check the current Spring Family Weekend schedule for attendance details.

cards.title: Mark winter at Mistletoast
cards.subtitle: Early-December holiday-season gathering
cards.notes: Watch for the first Friday in December and browse the crafts fair or enjoy the program’s big-band dancing and food.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gathering welcomes the winter holiday season.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound describes Mistletoast as a winter-holiday-season tradition featuring a crafts fair, big-band dancing, and food, typically on the first Friday in December.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the first Friday in December; verify the current program and access details.

cards.title: Turn a fast into local support
cards.subtitle: Annual campus hunger-relief tradition
cards.notes: Find the annual campus information and follow its donation guidance to support local food banks and other charities.
cards.short_summary: A Thanksgiving-season observance channels campus giving toward hunger relief.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says its annual Thanksgiving Fast for Hunger encourages the campus to donate to local food banks and other charities.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Look for annual campus communications; donations are optional.

cards.title: Read the names beneath the cherry trees
cards.subtitle: February remembrance outside Wheelock Student Center
cards.notes: Visit the cherry trees outside Wheelock in February and take time with the signs naming students whose education was interrupted by incarceration.
cards.short_summary: The campus publicly remembers students displaced during World War II.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound says that each February it places signs naming Puget Sound students of Japanese ancestry whose education was interrupted by World War II incarceration beneath the cherry trees outside Wheelock Student Center.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Acknowledged each February outside Wheelock Student Center.

cards.title: Gather for Senior Class Dinner
cards.subtitle: Annual spring tradition for graduating students
cards.notes: Eligible seniors should watch graduation communications for registration, timing, and any attendance details for this annual class gathering.
cards.short_summary: The graduating class has its own annual spring dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound lists the annual Senior Class Dinner among its spring traditions.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: For graduating students; verify current eligibility, registration, and any cost with the university.

cards.title: Make room for a Swope Lecture
cards.subtitle: Campus series on faith, ethics, values, or religion
cards.notes: Check upcoming-event listings for a guest lecture, then bring a question connected to faith, ethics, values, or religion.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus lecture series centers consequential questions and guest speakers.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound lists the Swope Lecture series as a tradition bringing guest lecturers on faith, ethics, values, or religion.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Traditions | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Scheduling and venue vary; consult the university’s current events information.
